answer.rationale: Constraints prune the field before memory does. Rollback is ruled out by compliance regardless of how well memory_b1 worked on day 18. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) fail fast by design, which at settlement peak on the write path means shedding customer writes — directly against the stated objective. Regional failover (memory_b2) moved traffic cleanly during a latency degradation, but that record is about latency recovery, not about write durability during a heavy-write peak; cutting a region over mid-settlement risks in-flight writes, which is exactly the loss we are told to avoid. That leaves relieving load on the primary or adding headroom. memory_b5 is the closest structural match to the present symptom: read contention on the primary depressing transactional write latency, resolved by moving report/dashboard queries off. It is also reversible and does not touch the write path itself. memory_b3 describes headroom provisioned BEFORE a peak; we are 90 minutes into a live climb, so its precondition is already violated — provisioning now likely lands after the window, which is why I want its source record to see the actual lead time. I want memory_b5's source to confirm the causal mechanism was genuinely read contention and not a coincident change, since that is the whole basis for this pick. Uncertainty I am not resolving: this inherited set is entirely composed of interventions that worked. Six memories, six successes, no recorded failure or non-event. That is a survivorship-shaped record, and it will systematically overstate how reliably any of these levers transfers to a new context. It also cannot tell me whether the current write-path climb is read contention at all — it may be the 2-hour-old release itself, in which case routing reads buys partial relief at best and the real fix waits for the next window. I am therefore scoping this as a small guarded test on the heaviest reporting queries with write latency and replica lag watched directly, so that a null result is legible as a null result rather than being absorbed as another success into the memory these future sessions inherit.
